message.content:
A rectangular editorial illustration features a light blue background. At the top, red text reads "TEMPO" in a large, serif font, above "ENAK DIBACA DAN P". Black text at the upper left reads "Balik Badan Penundaan Pemilu H.26" and upper right reads "Menakar Prospek Saham Perdana GoTo H.72". A barcode and QR code are in the upper right corner above the date "21-27 MARET 2022" and "RP 50.000".

The illustration depicts three men in two sports cars. A man with dark hair, sunglasses, and a grey blazer drives a yellow, open-top sports car angled downward to the right. A second man in a white shirt with his arms raised sits in the passenger seat of a silver sports car angled upward to the left. A third man with a beard and a white shirt drives the silver car. Dozens of green banknotes fall around them.

The lower left corner contains white text: "MUDA, KAYA, TERSANGKA", "Sejumlah anak muda tiba-tiba jadi superkaya dengan bisnis ilegal mirip perjudian. Kedok pencucian uang. H.54".
